items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I knew him. All the harm he did was to himself... And how Lil could tolerate him, I don't know. Because she was such a good girl. Lil was a good girl.

ctx.x: No, indeed. She had a fit when she heard that Lil was going to marry Louis. But Louis was a good boy. There wasn't nothing wrong with Louis.
